releaseSemantics.opening: Owner-approved immutable preseason projection issued before the first regular-season game.
releaseSemantics.current: Actual outcomes through cutoff plus forecasts for every remaining scheduled game.
releaseSemantics.ros: Forecast distribution for every remaining scheduled game, excluding recorded outcomes.

rosterIntegrity.automaticResolution: Official roster plus player landing, or player landing plus official transaction, must agree with no newer contradiction.
rosterIntegrity.omissionPolicy: An offseason official-roster omission never proves release, departure, or ineligibility.
rosterIntegrity.conflictPolicy: Single-source and contradictory evidence remain review-required; evidence and resolutions are append-only.

rookieModel.source: Checksum-captured official NHL player landing seasonTotals.
rookieModel.eligibleLeagues: League histories are admitted only after identifiers and year-to-year definitions pass the freeze audit.
rookieModel.translation: League, age, position, draft slot, recency, development trajectory, organization depth, deployment, and team environment enter a chronologically learned and hierarchically shrunk NHL-equivalency model.
rookieModel.peripheralFallback: Unavailable non-NHL peripherals use position-age-league cohort priors with stronger shrinkage and wider intervals.
rookieModel.disclosure: Every no-NHL-history output reports rookie status, source coverage, roster probability, NHLe method, and fallback flags.

targets.assistPolicy: Primary and secondary assists remain separate targets and their unweighted sum is official assists. Fixed 70:30 and 80:20 weighting is prohibited.
targets.strengthPolicy: EV, PP, SH, and empty-net event labels are mutually exclusive under the versioned normalized-PBP classifier; shootouts are excluded.

modeling.venueBias: Hits, blocks, takeaways, and giveaways include chronologically estimated venue-scorer effects.
modeling.selection: A challenger is served only when chronological loss and calibration beat the frozen baseline without critical subgroup regression.
modeling.fallback: The strongest valid frozen baseline remains available per target.

sourceEligibility.availabilityScope: Coverage is target-specific. A season whose settled source does not expose a target is unavailable, not a zero-valued failure.
sourceEligibility.fallback: A target failing this gate remains on its strongest valid frozen baseline and is disclosed; it does not invalidate unrelated targets.

modeling.gameAggregation: Every remaining scheduled game is forecast independently; H1 is never multiplied by 84.
modeling.uncertainty: Correlated simulation reconciles identities and produces p10, p50, and p90.

evaluation.consumedLockboxPolicy: The 2025-26 lockbox is validation and training evidence, never new blind evidence.
evaluation.intervalCalibration: Rolling-origin standardized residuals use randomized conformal boundary handling. calibration80Coverage is expected randomized coverage; ordinary discrete overcoverage is reported separately, and untouched 2026-27 coverage remains required prospective evidence.
evaluation.settlement: Model and editorial values are settled separately using append-only revisions.

publication.unhealthyPolicy: Retain the last good release and expose a non-sensitive hold reason.
publication.fantasyScoring: Downstream transform of published raw outcomes; never a model target.

security.editor: Valid user token, admin role, and sole UUID allowlist membership.
security.cron: Cron may enqueue and publish a healthy validated run but may not edit projections.

acceptance.roster: Zero resolved-vs-official mismatches, zero duplicate current memberships, and zero unresolved high-confidence conflicts.
acceptance.determinism: Identical artifact, feature, roster, schedule, and override inputs produce byte-equivalent canonical outputs.
